method: Every rebuilt PDF was rendered with Poppler at 180 dpi. Each resulting image was opened with view_image at readable resolution, in addition to exact canonical/rebuilt pixel comparison.

notes.fig1: Both specified one-unit example paths, state labels and arrows are clear and within the frame.
notes.fig2: Client/service regions, lifecycle nodes, cancellation and no-ACK recovery path are legible and unclipped.
notes.fig3: Both scenario panels, all phase/metric labels and 36 saved numerical cells are readable.
notes.fig4: Both response conditions, all eight counts, both policy/client labels, legend and 144-task axis are clear.
notes.fig5: All 12 conditions, both applicable estimands, 60 intervals, zero lines and axis labels are visible. The precision/coverage tick-label gutter is separated.

hash_binding: The exact rebuilt PDF and canonical reference hashes are recorded per figure in REBUILD_COMPARISON.json; all five PDF pairs are byte-equal and all compared pixels are equal.
scope: Standalone current-figure package only; no new manuscript-wide or scientific-outcome review.
